pages.title: Merge Land
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Merge supplies to help an island community in Merge Land. Combine identical items into materials needed for tasks, then use them to repair buildings and open tropical locations. Meet new characters as your work restores more of their surroundings.

pages.title: Animals Merge
pages.creator: MidnightAegis
pages.description: Begin with chickens and develop a collection of creatures in Animals Merge. Buy and place animals so identical pairs can combine into rarer species. Leave useful spaces on the board as you work from small pets toward larger and legendary beasts.

pages.title: Doctor Chicken
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help transformed patients return to normal in Doctor Chicken. Move the doctor to find the correct candy medicine for each little monster who arrives. Bring the treatment back to the patient and keep working until the town's children are healed.

pages.title: Block Blast Jewel Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Fit gem-covered shapes into a grid in Block Blast Jewel Puzzle. Complete rows or columns to clear pieces and leave room for another placement. Try Classic, Timer or Level mode depending on whether you want an open-ended score, a countdown or set objectives.

pages.title: Unicorn Princess Dress Up
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Style a fantasy doll in Unicorn Princess Dress Up. Choose clothing, try hairstyles and apply eye makeup to build the princess's appearance. Compare the pieces as you work toward a coordinated outfit with a unicorn-inspired look.

pages.title: Sprunki Phase Brainrot
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Take Italian meme characters through strange levels in Sprunki Phase Brainrot. Run and jump as figures such as Tralalero Tralala or Frigo Camelo, reacting to the surreal obstacles along the way. Try different characters as you explore the reskinned Sprunki world.

pages.title: Escape or Die - Troll Devil Levels
pages.creator: ultra meow
pages.description: Find a route through deceptive platforming rooms in Escape or Die - Troll Devil Levels. Watch how the traps change when you move and learn what each surprise does to the path. Use those discoveries to get the character through the dungeon alive.

pages.title: Spiderlox Theme Park Battle
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Explore a large attraction as a web-themed hero in Spiderlox Theme Park Battle. Move between parts of the park and fight the enemies you find there. Use the surroundings and the hero's mobility to get through each encounter.

pages.title: Mutant Assassin 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Snare opponents with webs in Mutant Assassin 3D, then finish them with punches. Check the terrain and choose targets that let you stay in control of the fight. Clear four stages before facing the boss encounter that tests the same abilities.

pages.title: Turbo Car Track
pages.creator: Skilli
pages.description: Steer through increasingly winding courses in Turbo Car Track. Collect gold to unlock stronger vehicles while managing the rising speed. Read the next bend early enough to keep the car on the road through each difficult stretch.

pages.title: Ghost Escape 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Collect posters and pictures to unlock an escape in Ghost Escape 3D. Search the haunted hospital quietly because the ghost reacts to noise. Use the map or hint controls when needed while finding the remaining items without being caught.

pages.title: Fruit Ninja
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Swipe a blade through fruit in Fruit Ninja. Slice several targets together when you can and stay alert for hazards mixed into the action. Try the three classic modes for different ways to test your timing and build a higher score.

pages.title: Obby Parkour Ultimate
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Clear thirty-five platforming stages in Obby Parkour Ultimate. Choose an Obby or block-style character, jump between platforms and avoid spikes on the way to the finish. Unlock more characters as you complete the increasingly difficult routes.

pages.title: Stickman Epic
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Develop a fighter in Stickman Epic. Choose one of three characters, equip armor and open reward chests as you progress. Work through fifteen levels and prepare for six bosses, using the different equipment options to improve the hero's strength.

pages.title: Monster Egg Brawl
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Merge equal-level creatures into stronger fighters in Monster Egg Brawl. Collect stars to level up and stay clear of enemy attacks while the round's timer runs. Survive to the end to improve your rank and attempt tougher monster battles.

pages.title: Hillside Drive Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Bring three stick figures up a mountain in Hillside Drive Master. Guide the truck over uneven terrain and keep the trip moving toward the summit. Pick up coins for mystery gifts while trying to complete each unusual delivery.

pages.title: Little Farm Clicker
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Plant crops, raise animals and sell what they produce in Little Farm Clicker. Use the income to improve the farm and develop more sources of revenue. Keep balancing production and purchases as the holding grows.

pages.title: Escape from dinosaurs
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Gather planks before dinosaurs catch you in Escape from dinosaurs. Use the boards to build a ladder toward a waiting pterodactyl. Hide behind trees, distract hunters with chickens or slow them with bombs while collecting enough wood to leave.

pages.title: Funny Shooter 2
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Fight groups of strange enemies in Funny Shooter 2. Move with WASD, aim with the mouse and change weapons as the attackers crowd the area. Improve the arsenal between encounters to handle stronger groups of the absurd opponents.

pages.title: Brick Breaker Retro
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Keep a ball in play to clear formations in Brick Breaker Retro. Drag to set the initial aim, then move the paddle under each return. Angle the rebounds toward bricks that are hard to reach from below.

pages.title: 4WD Off-Road Driving Sim
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Drive six types of off-road vehicles in 4WD Off-Road Driving Sim. Start with an older SUV and work toward stronger trucks, vans and four-wheel drives. Follow muddy forest roads to the blue waypoint circles while keeping the vehicle under control.

pages.title: BowArcher Tower Attack
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: Defend a castle with a bow in BowArcher Tower Attack. Aim at the advancing enemies and fire before they can bring down the tower. Work through the different attackers as the defense faces another wave.

pages.title: Red and Blue Stickman Huggy 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help two brothers leave a submerged temple in Red and Blue Stickman Huggy 2. Collect the diamonds needed for the key and guide both characters past hazards. Keep moving toward safety because neither of the twins can swim.

pages.title: Rainbow Social Media Influencers
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Put together colorful spring looks in Rainbow Social Media Influencers. Choose bright clothing, try a hairstyle and finish with fresh makeup for each character. Mix the pieces to give the group different interpretations of the seasonal trend.

pages.title: City Siege Factions Island
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Build a force for rescue and combat missions in City Siege Factions Island. Begin with a rifleman, then recruit vehicles and specialists such as spies or helicopters. Use the team to remove enemies while bringing people out of danger.

pages.title: Basketball With Buddies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Flick a ball into the hoop in Basketball With Buddies. Compete against a friend or the computer in a sixty-second round, aiming to score more baskets. Read the arc of each attempt to improve the next shot.

pages.title: Monsters Color Fill
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Swipe a creature through a maze in Monsters Color Fill to paint every floor tile. Plan around the corners so no blank section becomes unreachable. Try to finish all sixty layouts with fewer moves.

pages.title: Panda Lifestyle
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Join a panda's day around town in Panda Lifestyle. Visit the cafe, clean the park fountain and spend time playing with friends. Finish by choosing a hairstyle and outfit for the panda's next outing.

pages.title: Flat Jumper
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Change a bouncing ball's color in Flat Jumper so it matches the platform ahead. Watch the color of the next horizontal piece before switching. Keep the sequence correct as the pace changes to build a higher score.

pages.title: Double StreetFight
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight through missions with a friend in Double StreetFight or enter an eight-player free-for-all. Knock down enemies to collect coins and buy costumes for your fighter. Try the single-player campaign when you want to take on the three missions alone.

pages.title: Zombie Shooter 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Aim at the undead in Zombie Shooter 2D. Look at the placement of targets and obstacles before choosing where to fire. Work through fifteen shooting puzzles by finding a way to remove every zombie.

pages.title: Ninja Fishing
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Slice fish as they leap across the screen in Ninja Fishing. Cut each one before it falls away and keep the blade clear of bombs. Choose a mode and see how long you can continue without losing the available lives.

pages.title: Bullet Bender Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a projectile after it leaves the gun in Bullet Bender Online. Slide to curve around obstacles, strike the enemies and keep the hostage safe. Check the whole route before steering the shot toward its final target.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Mineblox
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a block-inspired drawing in Easy Kids Coloring Mineblox. Apply colors to the character and the surrounding details, then change any area you want to try differently. Work through the pages at your own pace.

pages.title: Animal Cars Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Swap tiles into groups of three or more in Animal Cars Match 3. Look for matches that let you quickly make another group as the board changes. Keep the side meter from dropping too low to stay in play.

pages.title: 2021 Opel Mokka e Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six car pictures in 2021 Opel Mokka e Puzzle. Pick sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four or one hundred pieces and use the vehicle's lines to connect the sections. Complete the image before choosing another view of the car.

pages.title: Diamonds Mission
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Match falling gems with the pieces below them in Diamonds Mission. Use left or right clicks to switch the arrangement before a jewel arrives. Keep matching as successful plays make the diamonds drop faster.

pages.title: Modern OffRoad Uphill Truck Driving
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Deliver loads along mountain tracks in Modern OffRoad Uphill Truck Driving. Take a heavy trailer past sharp bends and uneven sections while keeping the cargo secure. Bring items such as pallets, drums and gas cylinders to their destinations.

pages.title: Hidden Ocean Pollution
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Search underwater scenes for discarded objects in Hidden Ocean Pollution. Look through each picture and select the rubbish concealed among the marine surroundings. Complete the collection for a level before visiting another part of the polluted ocean.

pages.title: Circle Jump
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Jump around a circular track in Circle Jump. Read where the next spike is positioned and time a tap to pass it without contact. Keep the character moving safely to extend the run and improve the score.

pages.title: Valentines Day Find Odd One Out
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Look for a single altered symbol in Valentines Day Find Odd One Out. Compare the details of the Valentine icons and choose the one that differs from its neighbors. Clear the current set before inspecting another arrangement.

pages.title: Jumping Alien 1.2.3
pages.creator: ika games
pages.description: Recover scattered rocket parts in Jumping Alien 1.2.3. Tap to jump, using up to three steps to get over hazards and reach higher ground. Find the pieces lost after the meteor impact so the alien can rebuild its craft.

pages.title: Dumb Riders
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Survive obstacle courses on a skateboard, golf cart or old bike in Dumb Riders. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to manage the vehicle through each hazard. Try player-made stages or create a course for other riders to attempt.

pages.title: Zombie Card Games : Matching Card
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Reveal matching undead pictures in Zombie Card Games : Matching Card. Remember where the cards are hidden and turn identical ones over together. Wrong choices let the zombies attack, so make each guess count while clearing the board.

pages.title: Funny Nose Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help Mia during a simulated clinic visit in Funny Nose Surgery. Follow the prompts to select tools and treat the problems in her nose. Complete the care steps, then decorate her nose with stickers at the end.

pages.title: Super Wash
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Clean dirty objects with a pressure washer in Super Wash. Move the nozzle over muddy areas and check for patches you have missed. Keep rinsing until the whole object is clean enough to finish the stage.

pages.title: BTS Cute Girl Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick a character drawing and paint it in BTS Cute Girl Coloring. Choose shades for the clothing, hair and surrounding details, then try another combination when you want to change the picture. Work through the pages with the mouse or touch controls.

pages.title: Locometry
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Match loose shapes with the spaces on a train in Locometry. Look at the outline of each opening before choosing the piece that fits. Place all the requested shapes to complete the train's current puzzle.

pages.title: Choli Food Drop
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Move a hungry chicken beneath falling food in Choli Food Drop. Catch the edible pieces while steering away from other objects mixed into the shower. Watch where the next item will land before choosing which way to run.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Granny House
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Visit a relative's home in Baby Hazel Granny House. Help Hazel and her grandparents with the activities that come up during the stay. Explore the house and nearby places while keeping track of what everyone needs.

pages.title: 3D Soccer Champions
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Move footballers into position in 3D Soccer Champions. Use the arrow keys to dribble toward the opposing goal and press space to shoot. Defend your own end when the other team gains the ball and look for another chance to score.

pages.title: Hexagon Pals
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Place clusters on a honeycomb-shaped board in Hexagon Pals. Fill straight lines through the grid to clear blocks and score, using both the horizontal and diagonal directions. Keep openings that can accept the shapes still waiting to be placed.

pages.title: Number Composition
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Choose the correct arithmetic composition in Number Composition to advance a race car. Each right answer carries your driver farther along the rally, giving you a chance to overtake. Keep solving to bring the car to victory.

pages.title: BTS Mask Boy Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color a masked character in BTS Mask Boy Coloring. Select a shade, paint the outlined details and work through the picture one area at a time. Try different colors for the costume to give the drawing your own look.

pages.title: Russian Cars Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find seven changes per image in Russian Cars Differences. Compare the vehicles and their surroundings before selecting each altered detail. Work through ten levels, finishing the current pair before its timer expires.

pages.title: EG Barrier
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Steer through openings in road obstacles in EG Barrier. Keep the car from hitting either side of a gap and collect stars when they are within reach. React earlier as the increasing speed makes each crossing harder.

pages.title: Cars Traffic King
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Control signal changes at a busy junction in Cars Traffic King. Let vehicles move when their paths are clear and stop them when another flow needs to pass. Prevent crashes and try to complete every traffic-control stage with three stars.

pages.title: Spill It!
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drop balls onto fragile containers in Spill It! Move a ball above the point you want to strike and release it to knock glasses over. Work through one hundred physics layouts, using each hit to spill the remaining contents.

pages.title: Basketball Flip
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Arrange objects to guide a falling ball into the hoop in Basketball Flip. Drag barriers into position and double-click to rotate them before releasing the ball. Use the helper if needed as you solve fifty-six different setups.

pages.title: Bandits Multiplayer PVP
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride into combat in Bandits Multiplayer PVP. Choose among horses and weapons, then fight other riders or take on zombies across three maps. Try modes such as deathmatch or battle royale for a different kind of encounter.

pages.title: Princess BFF Burning Man
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Put together festival outfits for four friends in Princess BFF Burning Man. Browse the clothing and accessories and create a separate look for each character. Coordinate the pieces before the group heads to the event.

pages.title: Coloring Underwater World 5
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Color fish scenes in Coloring Underwater World 5. Choose free mode for your own palette, or study the hint in challenge mode and reproduce its colors. Work toward five stars by remembering the reference accurately.

pages.title: Space Blaze
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shoot incoming spacecraft in Space Blaze and collect stars from the battles. Spend them on improvements and work toward the five available ships. Use the mouse or keyboard to stay clear of enemies while lining up another attack.

pages.title: The Gap
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Gather cubes on an endless course in The Gap. Watch the approaching walls and choose a route that avoids them without leaving useful pickups behind. Stay in play to build a larger cube total and a higher score.

pages.title: Bitcoin Clicker
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Click to accumulate virtual currency in Bitcoin Clicker. Keep adding to the total and work toward a larger score as the counter grows. Try another session to see how much you can produce through repeated clicks.

pages.title: Lumber Runner
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Keep Jack and his friends balanced on a rotating log in Lumber Runner. Adjust their movement as the surface spins and pick up gold coins along the way. Stay upright longer to collect more before the run ends.

pages.title: Text Rush
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Keep up with incoming messages in Text Rush. Watch the crowded screen and respond to the texts and emoticons as they appear. Work quickly enough to stay ahead of the growing conversation.
